How to play

  • Take turns drawing one line between two dots next to each other.
  • Draw the fourth side of a box and it's yours: you score a point and draw again.
  • When every box is claimed, the player with the most boxes wins.
  • Try not to draw the third side of a box. That hands it to the other player!
